changes.comment: New `store.metrics()` (with `StoreMetrics`): queue depth, effects in flight, dedup hits and dedup entries, cheap enough to read on every metrics scrape. New `store.whenIdle()`: resolves when no event waits to be reduced and no effect runs, for a graceful shutdown; a call waiting for its reply and pending timers do not delay it, and every wait resolves on dispose.
